findings.fix: Hold until a human adds products of (relative) diffeomorphism groups to the layer-3 roadmap, or amend the description to name a real, proximate layer-3 use (the current 'product-region' rationale references layer-2 topological embeddings, not smooth diffeomorphism groups).
findings.issue: New mathematical content (prodHom : Diff(M)×Diff(N)→Diff(M×N), relativeProdHom, and the product-fixing/injectivity API) has no proximate path to a named layer-3 target. Layer 3's build list (roadmap README lines 372–390) and targets (Smale/Diff(S³), Watanabe/π_k(Diff(D⁴,∂)), Diff(M,∂M)) are all single-manifold; none needs a product diffeomorphism group. Unlike the merged FixingSubgroup/RelativeCongr track, which builds/transports the named object Diff(M,∂M), this constructs a new object on a new manifold M×N.

summary: The product homomorphism Diff(M)×Diff(N)→Diff(M×N) and its relative version introduce product manifolds M×N that appear in no named layer-3 target; layer 3's build list and targets (Smale on Diff(S³), Watanabe on π_k(Diff(D⁴,∂)), Diff(M,∂M)) are all single-manifold and mention no product construction. The stated 'product-region' justification cites layer-2 locally-flat topological embeddings, a different layer and category, so I see no proximate path to a roadmap target.
